note: Expectations are product judgements written before the 0.2.0 ranker was run against these fixtures. A mismatch is a finding, not a build failure to tune away. `safe` is what the tool should ship by default; `reach` is the more ambitious offer, when one clears the gates. Mismatches listed under knownGaps are expected failures: the run shows them but does not go red, so a regression cannot hide behind them.

quiet-docs.rationale: Airy 12 and expressive 6 put every louder family at least 14 points below the dot. There is no second offer that fits; naming one would invent ambition the page does not have. The fallback is the zero-JS cursor for a buyer who forbids JS.

product-saas.rationale: Moderate expression, one accent, 100vh hero: polish without personality is the brief.

agency-portfolio.rationale: Six project cards and a 7rem serif — labels are what the visitor notices. The reach is the reveal, which the image set already supports.

photo-editorial.rationale: Image-led editorial. Safe is the labelled cursor; the reach is the reveal, which needs the image set this site has.

glass-dashboard.rationale: Dense console with glass panels. Blend-difference is demoted by the stacking context, and a ring would cover the controls the pointer is aiming at.

form-app.rationale: Form-first page: the caret must stay native and nothing may compete with the fields. Same as quiet-docs — every louder family is more than 10 fit points down, so none is offered.

shader-hero.rationale: The site already ships three and a hero canvas, so the expensive family is already paid for; the safe pick stays the labelled cursor.

studio-showcase.rationale: Maximum expression, 20 images, no serif display — a particle ribbon is native to this register and a label system is not.

knownGaps.statement: Fit charges for a miss and never rewards a family for having an opinion. dot-ring's bands cover almost any site (expressive 30-80, airy 30-100, editorial 0-75), so it sits at or near 100 and wins by default. state-label requires expressive >= 55 and editorial >= 50 - a real opinion about these three sites - and loses for holding it. The score also discounts a full-band miss to about 3% after the fifth root, so even an outright contradiction barely costs anything.

reach may be at most one tier above safe. When the safe pick is T1, T3 is unreachable even on a repo that already imports three and where shader-ripple clears the floor at 80. The cap is doing its job on cost, but it means the GPU family can only ever be offered to a site already loud enough to pick a T2 safely.
